# milestone 4: verification slice backlog

## purpose

The trackable **`M4-S-###`** slice backlog for milestone 4 (advanced verification).
The **definition of done**, scope decisions, macro phases (P0–P4), and completion
criteria live in the hub **`task/sv0-toolchain-milestone-4-verification.Rmd`**; the
per-epic engineering notes live in the owning sub-tasks (`task/sv0c-*.Rmd`). This
file is a **living index** — flip status as slices land and keep it aligned with
the hub's phase narrative.

## how to use

- Pick the next slice by macro phase (hub P0→P4); slices within a phase are roughly
  ordered by dependency.
- Each slice names its **owning sub-task**, an **acceptance** signal, and its
  **phase**. Add a one-line result + commit when a slice lands (like the M3 checklist).
- Keep the spec (`sv0doc`) aligned before claiming new `sv0 verify` behavior (Epic F).

| M4-S-001 | contract-expression IR (flat arena; vars, literals, comparisons, `&&`/`||`/`!`, `+ - * / %`, `old`, `result`) | P0 | **done** | `lib/verify_vcgen.sv0` — arena builders + evaluator + 6 unit tests; gated (stage0 golden + self-host loop 99). `forall`/`exists` deferred to a later slice. |
| M4-S-002 | extract parsed contract clauses (requires/ensures/loop_invariant) into the IR | P0 | **done** | `extract_cexpr` in `lib/verify_vcgen.sv0` translates the body-expr arena (parser output: lit/path/unop/binop/call) → CExpr; `result`→CResult, `old(e)`→COld via the arg sidecar, vars interned into `var_names`; unsupported forms (qualified paths, string/unit lits, bitwise/shift, forall/exists, other calls) → -1 (residual, soundness). 4 extraction tests (compare, result+arith, old, unsupported) on hand-built arenas matching the parser encoding; gate green. |
| M4-S-003 | VC generator — straight-line body (assume `requires`, assert `ensures` at return) | P0/P1 | **done** | `vc_gen_ensures_query` in `lib/verify_vcgen.sv0`: obligation for an ensures = `requires… ∧ (result==return_expr) ⟹ ensures` (requires assumed — caller's obligation). Tested on `f(x) requires(x>0) ensures(result>=1){return x;}` → the exact query z3 proves **unsat** (+ negative: no requires → **sat**/residual). |
| M4-S-004 | VC generator — branches (if/else path conditions) | P1 | todo | contract proven on one branch, residual on the other |
| M4-S-005 | VC generator — loops via `loop_invariant` (entry ∧ preservation ∧ exit) | P1 | todo | a loop-based `ensures` proven via its invariant |
| M4-S-006 | `old(expr)` snapshot + `result` binding in VCs | P1 | **done** | `ensures(result == old(x) + 1)` / `ensures(result > old(x))` verify end-to-end. `result` binds to the straight-line return value (M4-S-003); `old(e)` denotes the pre-state — in the straight-line fragment parameters are immutable, so `old(x) == x` and it soundly renders as the current SMT var (distinct pre-state snapshot variables become observable only under mutation/loops, M4-S-004/005). **Soundness guard added** (`vc_body_has_effect`): a body containing reassignment (ExprAssign/AssignOp) or control flow (if/match/while/for/loop) is NOT straight-line — result-binding + `old(x)==x` would be invalid — so every ensures there is kept RESIDUAL. Fixes a real hole found in testing (`fn mutate(mut x){ x = x+1; return x } ensures(result==old(x))` was falsely [verified] → now [runtime]). Unit test `test_body_effect_guard` (14 verify_vcgen tests); corpus `oldstate.sv0` (bump/grow verified, mutate residual). |

### Epic C — `sv0 verify` + contract-mode (`task/sv0c-verify-cli.Rmd`)

| ID | slice | phase | status | acceptance |

| M4-S-020 | `sv0 verify` command (check → VCgen → solver → report) | P0/P1 | **done** | `./scripts/sv0 verify <file>` runs end-to-end. `verify_all_fns` (`lib/verify_vcgen.sv0`) walks the parser's item + body-expr arenas, classifies each contract clause's kind (back-scan from the expression's leftmost-leaf token to the nearest 83/61/73 keyword — parser stores the clause expr but not its keyword), extracts requires (assumed) + ensures (goal) + the straight-line return value via `extract_cexpr`, and emits one `VC\t<fn>\t<line>\t<smt2\|RESIDUAL>` record per ensures. Isolated native build (`scripts/build-sv0-megatu-verify-native.sh`: the 18-module pipeline + `verify_vcgen` + a derived verify main, own `/tmp/.sv0_verify_path` control file — shared compiler/VM/self-host gates untouched). `run_verify` in `scripts/sv0` runs each query through `sv0-z3.sh` → `[verified]`/`[runtime]` (unsat⇒verified; sat/unknown/absent/unsupported⇒runtime, sound). Gated: `scripts/verify_sv0_verify_e2e.py` on `test/verify/basic.sv0` (2 verified, 1 sound residual; skips if z3 absent). |
| M4-S-021 | per-contract human report (`[verified]`/`[runtime]` + reason, `sv0doc` §3.2 format) | P1 | **done** | `sv0 verify` now reports **every** contract clause (requires/ensures/loop_invariant) in source order, matching §3.2: `<file>:<line>  <clause>  [verified\|runtime]  -- <reason>` (aligned columns). | M4-S-022 | machine-readable (JSON) output for tooling/CI | P1 | **done** | `sv0 verify --json <file>` emits one object: `{"file","contracts":[{line,kind,clause,status,reason}…],"summary":{verified,runtime}}` (JSON-escaped via `_json_esc`). Reuses the same per-clause data as the §3.2 table (parent-only change — no compiler/golden churn). Unblocks the verify corpus + CI (M4-S-040/042). e2e test parses `--json` with Python `json` and cross-checks statuses + summary against the text report. |

## refinement log

- 2026-08-16: initial backlog created alongside the M4 hub. 26 slices across Epics A–F, tagged by macro phase P0–P4. Scope = full Phase 2+3 verification with a Z3-via-SMT-LIB2 backend (see hub scope decisions).
- 2026-08-21: **M4-S-006 done — old(expr) + result binding, with a soundness guard.** `old()` + `result` verify end-to-end for straight-line bodies (`ensures(result == old(x) + 1)` → verified). In this fragment params are immutable so `old(x) == x` (sound aliasing; distinct pre-state snapshot vars only matter once mutation/loops are modeled — M4-S-004/005). **Testing surfaced a real unsoundness:** a body that reassigns a param (`fn mutate(mut x){ x = x+1; return x } ensures(result==old(x))`) was falsely reported [verified] because the straight-line VC binds `result` to the syntactic return while treating the param as a fixed SMT const. Fixed with `vc_body_has_effect` — if the body contains assignment (18/19) or control flow (10-14) it is not straight-line, so all its ensures stay RESIDUAL (conservative: method calls + aggregates + unknown nodes also count as effectful). Unit test `test_body_effect_guard`; corpus `oldstate.sv0` (bump/grow verified, mutate residual). verify_vcgen 13→14 tests; corpus 12→16 contracts; golden refreshed.
- 2026-08-21: **M4-S-040 done — verify corpus gate.** `sv0c/test/verify/corpus/*.sv0` with inline `//@ verified`/`//@ runtime` expectations per contract (on the clause's line — a `//` comment the compiler ignores, so it moves with the clause and survives reordering). `scripts/verify_corpus.py` runs `sv0 verify --json` per file, checks each contract's status against its annotation in BOTH directions (a contract with no annotation, or an annotation with no contract, both fail — so adding a contract or regressing a status breaks the gate), wired into `./scripts/sv0 test` (skips if z3 absent). Negative-tested (flipped annotation → gate fails). Seed corpus = arithmetic.sv0 (4 fns) + residual.sv0 (2 fns) = 12 contracts. Built cleanly on the M4-S-022 `--json` output. Enables M4-S-042 (CI on the corpus — already covered since the corpus runs inside `sv0 test`, which CI runs).
- 2026-08-21: **M4-S-022 done — JSON output.** `sv0 verify --json <file>` emits one machine-readable object `{"file","contracts":[{line,kind,clause,status,reason}…],"summary":{verified,runtime}}` for tooling/CI, reusing the same per-clause data as the §3.2 text table (`_json_esc` for string fields). Parent-only (scripts/sv0 + e2e test) — no compiler/golden churn. e2e test now also runs `--json`, `json.loads` it, and cross-checks ensures statuses + summary against the text report. Unblocks M4-S-040 (corpus format) + M4-S-042 (sv0 verify in CI on the corpus).
- 2026-08-21: **M4-S-021 done — per-contract §3.2 report.** `sv0 verify` now lists **every** contract clause (requires/ensures/loop_invariant) in source order as `<file>:<line>  <clause>  [verified|runtime]  -- <reason>` (aligned). `verify_all_fns` emits `VC\t<line>\t<kind>\t<clause-text>\t<payload>` (payload = smt2 query | `RESIDUAL` | `PRECOND`); clause text is the source span from the keyword token to its matching `)` (`vc_match_rparen`), whitespace-collapsed (`vc_clause_text`); `vc_kind_name`/`vc_contract_kind_tok` name the kind. `run_verify` maps payload+z3-verdict → reason (requires = input precondition assumed locally; ensures unsat=proven / sat=counterexample / other=solver-unknown; loop_invariant + unsupported-ensures = residual; no-z3 = no solver). basic.sv0 → 2 verified, 5 runtime (the 5 = 4 requires preconditions + 1 unprovable ensures). verify_vcgen still 13 tests (test_verify_all_fns updated to the new multi-clause records + real clause text); e2e test updated; gate green.
- 2026-08-21: **M4-S-020 done — P0 EXIT: `./scripts/sv0 verify <file>` runs end-to-end on a real .sv0.** `verify_all_fns` (`lib/verify_vcgen.sv0`) walks the parser's item + body-expr arenas and emits one obligation record per `ensures`. Contract KIND is recovered without a parser change: the parser stores each clause's expression root but not its `requires`/`ensures`/`loop_invariant` keyword, and a clause is always `KEYWORD ( expr )`, so back-scanning from the expression's leftmost-leaf token to the nearest 83/61/73 token yields the keyword (`vc_contract_kind` + `vc_leftmost_leaf_tok`). Straight-line return value found by unwrapping the block's `return e;` statement (ExprStmt tag 28 → ExprReturn tag 15 → value) via `vc_find_return_value` — the tag-28 wrapper was the one real-parser surprise vs the hand-built unit arenas. **Isolated build** `scripts/build-sv0-megatu-verify-native.sh` assembles the 18-module pipeline + `verify_vcgen` + a verify-derived main (patched to read `/tmp/.sv0_verify_path` + emit records after the parse gate) into `build/sv0-megatu-verify`; the shared compiler/VM/self-host mega-TUs are untouched (own module manifest + control file, zero blast radius). `run_verify` in `scripts/sv0` runs each query through `sv0-z3.sh`: `unsat`⇒`[verified]`, everything else (sat/unknown/absent/RESIDUAL)⇒`[runtime]` (soundness — only a solid unsat strips). Gated by `scripts/verify_sv0_verify_e2e.py` on `sv0c/test/verify/basic.sv0` (f_pos_ge1→verified, g_not_ge100→runtime residual, h_sum_pos→verified; "2 verified, 1 runtime"), skips if z3 absent. verify_vcgen 12→13 tests (`test_verify_all_fns` on a hand-built item+contract arena). **The full chain IR→extract→VCgen→SMT→z3 now runs from source text.** Deferred to follow-ups: result-using ensures with branchy/multi-return bodies (M4-S-004/005) → RESIDUAL; per-contract reason strings + spec §3.2 shape (M4-S-021); `--project` verify.
- 2026-08-21: **M4-S-010 + M4-S-003 done.** `vc_build_query` wraps a goal + hypotheses into a full SMT-LIB2 `check-sat` query (auto QF_LIA/QF_NIA; `declare-const v<i> Int` per interned var + `result` when used; assert hyps + `assert (not goal)`). `vc_gen_ensures_query` builds the straight-line obligation for an ensures — `requires… ∧ (result==return_expr) ⟹ ensures`, with requires ASSUMED (caller's obligation, modular later). **End-to-end loop closed:** `test_vc_gen_ensures` asserts the exact query for `f(x) requires(x>0) ensures(result>=1){return x;}`, and `verify_z3_driver.py` feeds that byte-identical string to z3 → **unsat (proven)**; dropping the requires → **sat (residual)**. verify_vcgen 10→12 tests; z3 driver 6→8 cases; gate green (self-host loop 99).
- 2026-08-21: **M4-S-002 done** — extraction (body-expr arena → CExpr). `extract_cexpr` translates a parsed contract clause's expression subtree into the CExpr IR: int/bool literals (value from source, bool via token-tag 91), single-seg paths (`result`→CResult, else CVar with name-interning), unops (Neg/Not), binops (AST binop tag → CExpr op map: `>`8→9, `<=`9→8), and `old(e)` calls via the arg sidecar. Anything outside the fragment → -1 so the caller keeps the contract residual (soundness). Investigated + matched the exact parser encodings (binop 0-17, unop 0-5, lit d2=tok, path pp/seg, call callee/args/sidecar). 4 new extraction tests on hand-built arenas; verify_vcgen 6→10 tests, gate green (self-host loop 99, stage0 22). Next: finish M4-S-010 (VC query wrapping: set-logic + declare-const per var + assert hyps + assert ¬goal + check-sat) paired with M4-S-003 VC gen.
- 2026-08-17: **M4-S-011 done** — the z3 driver. `scripts/sv0-z3.sh` runs z3 with deterministic options and echoes one verdict per `(check-sat)` (`unsat`=proven / `sat`=refuted+model / `unknown`=residual); exit 2 when z3 is absent so callers degrade to all-runtime. Gated by `scripts/verify_z3_driver.py` (6 cases: proven, refuted, batch, and the `and`/`+`/`distinct`/`div`/`mod` emitter forms) in `./scripts/sv0 test`, skipping cleanly without z3; **z3 added to `ci.yml`** so it runs in CI. Full gate green (self-host loop 99).
- 2026-08-17: **M4-S-013 done** — host-process story DECIDED (driver-orchestrated: compiler write_files SMT-LIB, the `./scripts/sv0 verify` shell driver runs z3; verified-mode = two-pass with a proof-results file; graceful degradation when z3 absent → all-runtime). De-risked: z3 4.16.0 present, emitter operator forms (`and`/`+`/`distinct`/`div`/`mod`) all check-sat correctly (provable→unsat, unprovable→sat+model); linear→QF_LIA, div/mod/nonlinear→QF_NIA. See `sv0c-smt-backend.Rmd`.
- 2026-08-17: **P0 kickoff.** M4-S-001 **done** — contract-expression IR in a new `lib/verify_vcgen.sv0` (flat-arena `ct`/`cd1`/`cd2`/`cd3`, the compiler's idiom; `box_deref` does not return a typed enum so recursive Box<enum> is out) with builders + evaluator + 6 unit tests; wired into both bootstrap lists + a stage0 golden (self-host loop 99, stage0 22, native+SML parity). M4-S-010 **wip** — `cexpr_to_smt` emits QF_LIA+bool s-expressions, unit-tested. Next: M4-S-011 (z3 driver) + M4-S-013 (host-process decision).
